ev.q: In 2015, 3.5% of U.S. adults were current e-cigarette users.
Among adult e-cigarette users overall, 58.8% also were current cigarette smokers
Among adult e-cigarette users overall, 58.8% also were current cigarette smokers
among current e-cigarette users aged 18–24 years, 40.0% had never been cigarette smokers
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the noninstitutionalized U.S. civilian population
Source: National Health Interview Survey, 2015 data.

methods_quotes.q: Percentages are shown with 95% confidence intervals.
